_readme: Reviewed usage sentences for the Claude design system mirror. First matching pattern (a regular expression on the token name without the leading dashes) wins. The export script fails if a token has no note. Edit a sentence here, never in the generated tokens.json. Review these against the real component use when tokens change.

notes.usage: Page background. Primary text on it is gray-12, secondary text gray-11.
Cards and panels. Primary text on it is gray-12.
Quiet fills inside cards, for example table headers.
Hairline borders and dividers.
Accent for marks and highlights, for example the header accent line.
Accent bar on a card that needs review (the panel with tone review).
Accent colour for links and accent text on a surface.
Text or icon colour on an accent-mark fill.
App header background.
Background of a full-width band section.
Start and end colours of a hero area. Defined in the theme; check the component before relying on it.
Observed (from a scan or measurement) status chip: text, fill and border. Always shown with an icon and a word.
Inferred (unconfirmed) status chip: text, fill and border; also used for warning notes. Always shown with an icon and a word.
Confirmed (reviewed) status chip: text, fill and border; also used for success notes. Always shown with an icon and a word.
Unknown status chip: text and border. Always shown with an icon and a word.
Danger notes and errors: text, fill and border. Always shown with an icon and a word.
Coverage status text colour. Always shown with an icon and a label, never colour alone.
Text colour on the matching severity fill (the source comments record at least 4.5:1).
Severity scale fill, from most to least severe. Always shown with a label or count, never colour alone.
Brand primitive copied from the Proshore website palette (Relume). Components use the semantic tokens, not this one directly.
Focus ring colour (2px outline, 2px offset).
Neutral scale step 1 or 2: app and subtle backgrounds.
Neutral scale step 3 to 5: component backgrounds, hover and pressed states.
Neutral scale step 6 to 8: borders and separators.
Neutral scale step 9 or 10: solid fills and placeholder text.
Secondary text.
Primary text.
Neutral scale with transparency, for overlays and hairlines on any surface.
Neutral text steps with transparency; the same colours as the solid steps 9 to 12.
Accent scale step 1 to 8: tinted backgrounds, borders and hover states of accent elements.
Solid accent fill, for example the primary button.
Hover state of the solid accent fill.
Accent text and icons.
High-contrast accent text.
Accent scale with transparency, for soft fills, hover states and rings.
Accent steps 9 to 12 with the transparency variant name; the same colours as the solid steps.
Text on a solid accent fill.
Radix-compatible accent helper: surface tint, indicator and track colour. Defined in the theme for library compatibility.
Radix-compatible surface alias: page background, panel and card surfaces.
Scrim behind modal dialogs and drawers.
Tight gaps inside controls.
Gaps between related items; card padding.
Section and page spacing.
Tags and small chips.
Inputs, cards and panels (Relume small, medium and large are all 8px; steps kept for Radix compatibility).
Fully rounded shapes.
Pills: buttons and navigation links.
Cards and panels.
Card elevation: a soft shadow in light, a 1px inset hairline in dark.
Smallest permitted text (12px floor).
UI and body text; step 3 (1rem) is body.
Lead text and card titles.
Headings, from h4 (step 6) up to h1 and display (step 9).
